Method of Attack: Used PowerShell commands and CMD scripts to prepare system, disable security features, and execute ransomware payload
Impacted Systems: Windows data servers, compromised workstations using ConnectWise Control (ScreenConnect) software
Attack Vector: Deployment of ScreenConnect remote management software by attackers themselves on compromised workstations
Indicators of Compromise: PowerShell commands downloading and executing oxfordnew.exe or oxford.exe in C:\Windows\Temp folder
Registry file installation configuring public encryption key
